note: The published trend-following result (config default.yaml, out-of-sample from 2024-03-14) and the Phase 3 robustness studies used BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT daily candles up to 2026-11-09. For these two instruments the 2024-2026 part of the sealed test is therefore PARTIALLY CONTAMINATED: it was seen before the seal existed. Only instruments other than BTC and ETH are clean in the test period.

Building the manifest hashed every candle of both segments and the dataset report counted test-period instruments, rows, new listings and early endings. No price, return or strategy result of the test period was computed or looked at. Sealed test openings: 0.
Used only to estimate how spread and impact depend on traded value and volatility. Falls after test_end (2026-11-09), so it does not touch the sealed period.
segment: live market after the end of the dataset (not historical)
